snippet.title: Medic: Pacific War - Official Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Medic: Pacific War is OUT NOW in Early Access on Steam! 

Survive the horrors of the battlefield, dodge bullets, and bring salvation to the wounded. Be their last hope amid the chaos of the Pacific Front. Patch them up, revive them, and carry them to safety to change the course of battle. Be ready to make hard choices.

PLAY NOW on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1281640/Medic_Pacific_War/

Join our Discord community:
https://discord.gg/nPJKEsdGuJ

For more official updates, follow Medic: Pacific War on: 
X: https://x.com/medicpacificwar
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/medicpacificwargame
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MedicPacificWar
BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/medicpacificwar.bsky.social
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/MedicPacificWar/

Developed by Hypnotic Ants Studio.
